# Handy Pop!_OS

> Offline speech-to-text and voice typing for Pop!_OS 24.04, COSMIC Wayland,
> and PipeWire. The application runs Whisper-family or Parakeet transcription
> models locally and pastes recognized text into the active application.

Last verified: 2026-08-11
Current release: 0.9.5-popos.1
License: MIT
Repository: https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Handy-Pop-OS
Releases: https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/Handy-Pop-OS/releases

## Primary use cases

- Offline voice typing on Pop!_OS
- Local speech-to-text on COSMIC Wayland
- Whisper or Parakeet desktop dictation on Linux
- Multi-monitor speech transcription with a pointer-following overlay
- Temporary playback reduction during recording without changing master volume

## Distinctive capabilities

- Native non-focusable GTK layer-shell overlay on the pointer's current display
- Compact 72-pixel starting height and monitor-relative 400–760 pixel live width
- 82%-opaque charcoal overlay with soft shadow and cool-blue controls
- Streaming transcription display for models that support live recognition
- Configurable 0–90% PipeWire playback reduction while recording
- Private gain node that leaves master and saved application volumes unchanged
- Independent cleanup watchdog that restores routing after normal stop or crash
- Dark neutral interface and matching #7AA2F7 Linux tray icons
- Improved Wayland paste dispatch and responsive hidden startup
- Best-effort global shortcut recovery after suspend/resume
- Global hotkeys and CLI commands for switching downloaded models
- Three-model post-processing fallback chain
- Linux update checks disabled to preserve custom behavior

## Installation

Download Handy_0.9.5_amd64.deb from the latest GitHub release, then run:

sudo apt install ./Handy_0.9.5_amd64.deb
sudo usermod -aG input "$USER"

Log out and back in after adding the input group.

## Technical architecture

- Tauri 2 desktop application
- Rust backend
- React and TypeScript frontend
- GTK 3 and GTK layer shell native Linux overlay
- PipeWire and WirePlumber playback routing
- Local Whisper-family and Parakeet transcription
- Vulkan acceleration with CPU fallback
